title: Retire passive pre-cut-B retirement history under an approved reader floor
outcome: persisted retirement history is retired only under an explicitly approved reader-floor transition that preserves historical evidence or refuses before mutation
acceptance: Before any persisted ledger or type removal, the coordinator approves an exact reader-floor plan identifying the supported predecessor inventories, successor floor, treatment of nonempty historical retirement entries and original warnings, and rollback/refusal behavior. Historical evidence is not silently discarded or converted to revocation confirmation.

Under that approved plan, the active EngramRetiredWorkAuthorityGrant type, StateInner/PersistedState carrier and engramRetiredWorkAuthorityGrants metadata unit are retired together. Supported upgrades preserve the approved historical representation and unrelated state; unsupported or corrupt inputs and older readers refuse before mutation. A failed migration leaves the original header and data unchanged.

Disposable behavioral tests cover predecessor loading, empty and nonempty retirement history, preservation or explicit refusal under the approved policy, atomic migration failure, repeated restart, older-reader refusal and ordinary prompt delivery without any revoke/control invocation. Documentation describes the actual successor floor and historical-evidence treatment.
